ai_policy.summary: IOP permits AI-assisted research ideation, methods, analysis, code generation and text generation when appropriate, disclosed and validated. Authors must critically revise generated text and retain scientific reasoning, interpretation and accountability.

disclosure.instructions: For material research or manuscript contributions include an AI disclosure in Acknowledgements identifying tool or model, use and extent of verification, validation and critical review. Research use also requires details in Methods. Routine nonmaterial spelling, grammar and language editing is exempt; prompts and settings may be required where central to methods.

restrictions: Do not fabricate or manipulate original data or results.
Authors must independently evaluate and synthesize literature and verify citations.
AI must not generate reviewer responses; only language editing is allowed, and reviewer reports must not be uploaded.

policy_sources.applicability: Publisher policy explicitly applies to authors in IOP Publishing journals, including Progress in Energy.
policy_sources.note: Expressly permits research assistance, code generation, data analysis and critically revised generated text with disclosure and human responsibility.

disclosure.instructions: Declare manuscript-preparation AI before references with tool, purpose and confirmation of review and responsibility. restrictions: AI cannot replace human scientific judgement or intellectual contribution; authors must verify and edit output.
Do not fabricate or alter research data or results; restrictions apply to research images and graphical abstracts.
The publisher states AI use varies by journal; the journal-specific guide was inaccessible.
